basis.decisions: DD-070-1 to DD-070-6 as drafted (first measurement not reproduction; Spec 049's test form carried; population published before any join; no phase at draft; evidence observed_at of the draft; the AEE freeze gate in the DD-038-10 form), and the freeze rulings DD-070-7 to DD-070-14 at adjudication section 7 (intake record landed; Asset A digest copied; keying route; counting rule; POPULATION NOT KEYED disposition; own OSF registration; Phase 433; the gate reading)

design.question: Are Shakti's opening-strong signs the animal signs - Spec 049's question in re-scoped form, measured on the graded ICIT corpus with Spec 049's Mahadevan-population rule expressly replaced
design.battery: The recovered Phase-43 battery applied new to Shakti (section 2): sequences of length >= 2, I/M/T by position, floor total >= 5, cascade TERMINAL_STRONG t_rate >= 0.60, INITIAL_STRONG i_rate >= 0.55, MEDIAL_STRONG m_rate >= 0.65, TERMINAL_MODERATE t_rate >= 0.40, INITIAL_MODERATE i_rate >= 0.40, MIXED; threshold-only, no chance baseline (G5 attestation mandatory); the Phase-43 counts (805/2,267; the 40/61/20 classes) are never a basis for any product
design.populations: Primary: documented-lineage rows only. Sensitivity S-C: documented + corroborated rows, classes and counts re-derived; rows graded undocumented-uncorroborated enter no count anywhere
design.test: O is the INITIAL_STRONG set, enumerated in full in Wells space and published before any join; U is every sign with >= 30 occurrences in the primary population under the counting rule of DD-070-10; R1 is the animal share of O over the animal share of U, Fisher exact on the disjoint 2x2 (O against U minus O), the one-sided p the criterion and the two-sided p published; R2 the reversed arm
design.precedence: Section 4.3, carried from Spec 049's DD-049-3: NOT SUPPORTED if R1 <= 1.0 or p >= 0.05; SUPPORTED if R1 >= 1.5, p < 0.05 and R2 > 1.0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
design.keying: DD-070-9: a Shakti sign's ICIT code is its Wells number, resolved through the pinned canonical sign registry's parpola_1982 rows' wells_ids to exactly one Asset A sign_key; zero or multiple resolutions is unkeyable
design.disposition: DD-070-11 (conservative): an unkeyable sign enumerated in the opening-strong set closes the execution at gate 0.4 as POPULATION NOT KEYED, the sign named
design.sensitivities: S-A contested Asset A rows included under their CISI-governed labels (Asset A carries zero contested rows, so S-A equals the primary and is reported as such); S-B unicorn removed, the sign(s) named at gate 0.5 from the frozen asset's verbatim labels or S-B recorded not applicable; S-C the corroborated sensitivity
design.osf: DD-070-12: this spec files its own OSF registration at its freeze under the programme's OSF project; the filing is recorded in osf-spec-registration.md in this directory
design.execution_gate: Phase 433 executes only against this frozen record; step 0 asserts Asset A's digest (gate 0.1) and the Shakti intake under P-F1 S1/S2 (gate 0.2) before the population is enumerated (gate 0.4), the inventory published (gate 0.5), and the freeze-order proof given (gate 0.6)
design.limits: Depiction is the published identification layer, not ground truth; Spec 037's 49 percent census caution travels with every statement of the result; no outcome establishes that animal signs marked identity, a guild, or goods
